correctness.rationale: The paired-parent kernel is the exact mixture r*1_{x=y}/d+(1-r)/d²; independent later births give exact one-label and two-label avoidances u_d and v_d. Summing pair indicators produces both finite expectations. Telescoping upper bounds U*V <=(i-1)(j-1)/((n-1)(n-2)) give integrable majorants, and the pointwise limits yield the fixed-rate, mismatched-parent and vanishing-rate integrals. Independent exhaustive paired-history enumeration for n=3..6 at r=0,1/4,1/2,1, exact endpoint tests to n=19, and numerical limit checks passed using the packaged verify.py. These finite checks are not presented as proof of infinite asymptotics.

value.rationale: The exact invariant records pairwise genealogical motif persistence under independently sprinkled parent copying, rather than merely degree or leaf totals. Its distinct n*r² and accidental O(1) contributions give a sharp expected-overlap crossover at copying probability n^{-1/2}; the different-parent asymptotic shows that for every fixed positive copying rate the expected motif overlap is linear while the nonmatching-parent portion remains bounded. These features give a motivated statistic for studying structural survival of local genealogies under correlated network growth; no downstream testing guarantee is asserted.
